agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
June 11, 2019 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
RECOGNITION OF CITY EMPLOYEE FOR YEARS OF SERVICE - It is recommended the City Council recognize Jim Lathema for his years of service and present him with a service award pin and a certificate of appreciation.
Recognition of City Employee for Years of Services
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES – It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular meeting of May 28, 2019.
7.1 Minutes of May 28, 2019 CC
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER – It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated June 11, 2019 in the total amount of $2,917,577.08.
7.2 Warrant Register - City
7.3
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING APRIL 2019 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending April 2019.
7.3 Monthly Treasurer Report - April 2019
7.4
AUTHORIZATION TO PURCHASE 35 DESKTOP COMPUTERS - It is recommended the City Council authorize the purchase of 35 desktop computers from Dell Technologies in the amount of $31,477.16.
7.4 Authorization to Purchase Computers
7.5
AGREEMENT FOR JUVENILE PROBATION SERVICES FOR FISCAL YEAR 2019-20 - It is recommended the City Council approve an agreement with the County of Los Angeles for a Juvenile Probation Officer for Fiscal Year 2019-20 and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
7.5 Agreement for Juvenile Probation Services
7.6
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-05, SPLASH! WATERSLIDE INSTALLATION PROJECT - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council approve the plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2018-05, Splash! Waterslide Installation Project and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
7.6 CIP No. 2018-05
7.7
AGREEMENT WITH THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES FOR MUNICIPAL LAW ENFORCEMENT SERVICES - It is recommended the City Council approve the Agreement with the County of Los Angeles for Law Enforcement Services and authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement on behalf of the City of La Mirada.
7.7 Agreement with the County for MLES

8.1
RESOLUTION NO. 19-15 APPROVING A RATE ADJUSTMENT FOR REFUSE SERVICE AND ESTABLISHING RESIDENTIAL AND COMMERCIAL REFUSE RATES IN THE CITY OF LA MIRADA - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as prescribed by law and adopt Resolution No. 19-15 approving the proposed rate adjustment and establishing residential and commercial refuse rates in the City of La Mirada.
8.1 Resolution No. 19-15 Refuse Rates
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 19-16 AUTHORIZING THE SUBMITTAL OF A FUNCTIONAL CLASSIFICATION CHANGE REQUEST TO THE CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION FOR ESCALONA ROAD BETWEEN ROSECRANS AVENUE AND STAGE ROAD - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-16 authorizing the submittal of a Functional Classification Change Request to the California Department of Transportation for Escalona Road between Rosecrans Avenue and Stage Road.
9.1 Resolution No. 19-16 Reclassification of Escalona Road
